title: Rebuild Mcp App Dist Html
description: The dist/mcp-app.html in compose/engine/dist/ is stale (built 2026-03-30). It is missing all recent UI changes including: surface/mode routing in McpDesignViewer (show-design → ComposeDesign split, show-scene → ComposeScene 3D only), mcpFlattenDesignForComposeSurface, mergeRichestDesignFromCandidates priority logic, and splitLayout="always". As a result both start_working_in_design and show_scene show only the 2D diagram. Rebuild dist/mcp-app.html by running `npm run build:mcp-app` in compose/engine/.
